contexts.text: Beneath the buttocks there is a horrible Hell... SE 4505.
Under Adultery, see this reference, and at AC 5394. SE 4563.
They who have lived solely for themselves and for pleasure... are under the buttocks... SE 4548.
They who have come to honours and riches by machinations and cunning, there become magicians; they appear to sit beneath the buttocks...

They who are under the buttocks answer to those who are in the zenith in a perpendicular line, because they are of such a nature; but those below at the buttocks are carried away by the cupidity of punishing everyone in a subtle manner... SE 4086.
On the cruel under the buttocks.
Such are in Hell under the buttocks, in most filthy excrements... SE 4461:end.
Under Faith alone, see this reference.
Their buttocks uncovered () = the evils of self-love.
